notes: Upstream-clone debugging task on psf/requests at parent commit 96b22fa18c00831656ee4b286bf1c9062459b00a (real upstream bug, issue #6628). requests.exceptions.JSONDecodeError inherits from both InvalidJSONError (a RequestException, itself an IOError/OSError) and stdlib json.JSONDecodeError; because of the multiple-inheritance MRO pickle uses IOError.__reduce__ and reconstructs with a single message argument, so pickling the exception and unpickling it raises 'TypeError: JSONDecodeError.__init__() missing 2 required positional arguments: doc and pos' -- exactly what a multiprocessing pool hits when a worker fails to decode malformed JSON. Agent must reproduce (one-liner), localise the bug in the real tree (src/requests/exceptions.py), and add the upstream fix (an explicit __reduce__ on requests.exceptions.JSONDecodeError delegating to CompatJSONDecodeError.__reduce__); verifier runs the upstream regression test extracted from fix commit 3ff3ff21dd45957c9e143cd500291959bb15f690 into /opt/golden, the project's own self-contained test files, and three authored hidden cases exercising pickle protocols 0..HIGHEST, the Response.json() end-to-end path, and a cross-process pickle round-trip the upstream test does not cover. Dependency pins urllib3==2.7.0, certifi==2026.7.22, charset_normalizer==3.5.1, idna==3.19, PySocks==1.7.1, pytest==9.1.1. Pure Python, no network, <5s full verification. Fix direction observed in the task image before shipping.
